name: Visit the Herbalist
label: Quest
description: Guard Parker sends you to buy flowers for Darcy before you return to the Lakeshire inn. He wants the gift to stay secret.

clips.title: The story
paras: Guard Parker sends you to buy flowers for Darcy before you return to the Lakeshire inn. He wants the gift to stay secret.

At his post on Lakeshire's southern approach, Guard Parker watches for blackrock orcs and gnolls. You bring him a warm meal from Darcy at the Lakeshire Inn. Grateful for her kindness, Parker asks you to stop at the herbalist shop on the west end of town and buy flowers for her.

Parker asks you to keep the order private when you visit Martie Jainrose, the herbalist. Lakeshire is a small town, and he does not want Martie to know who sent the flowers or who will receive them. At the shop, Martie teases you, guessing you have already found a sweetheart in town. With orc incursions and brigands troubling Redridge, a small gesture of romance brings some welcome relief.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Before you go back to Darcy, can you bring her some flowers for me? You can get them at the herbalist shop back in Lakeshire, at the west end of town.
But when you get the flowers...don't tell the herbalist, Martie, whom they're from, or whom they're for...

clips.title: Completion
paras: You need a bouquet of flowers? You haven't been in town very long...have you already found for yourself a sweetheart here?
I know I shouldn't pry, but it's nice to see that love is in the air... Especially in dangerous times like these.

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
